Weighted toward primary sources, and '''every entry carries its reachability'''.
That last column is unusual in a bibliography and it is the point: five of the
nine primary sources below were not read during the writing of this volume, and a
reader is entitled to know which.

The full account of what that cost is on
[[Noether's theorems/Sources|the sources page]].

== Precursors Noether names herself ==

From her own footnotes, with the loci she gives. None was read.

Hamel, ''Mathematische Annalen'' 59, and ''Zeitschrift für Mathematik und
Physik'' 50. Herglotz, ''Annalen der Physik'' fourth series 36, section 9 at page
511. Fokker, ''Verslag'' of the Amsterdam Academy, 27 January 1917. Kneser,
''Mathematische Zeitschrift'' 2. Engel, Göttinger ''Nachrichten'' 1916, page 270.
She also refers the reader to Klein's second note for further literature.

'''A caution.''' Secondary reference lists sometimes give different Hamel papers
from the ones she cites. The loci above are hers, read from her footnotes.

== Secondary ==

Kosmann-Schwarzbach, ''The Noether Theorems: Invariance and Conservation Laws in
the Twentieth Century'', Springer 2011, translated from the French of 2004. The
standard scholarly treatment. Under copyright and not read. Her own open-access
article on the theorems in context was located and carries much of the same
historical material, including the correspondence chronology used on
[[Noether's theorems/Chronology|the chronology page]].

Hilbert's consolidated reprint of both communications, ''Mathematische Annalen''
92 (1924), 1–32, which records the division of credit between Klein and Noether.
Not reached in full text.

== Also cited, none read ==

Belinfante and Rosenfeld on the improvement of the stress-energy tensor; Hill's
1951 review; Yang and Mills 1954; Utiyama 1956 and Kibble 1961; Trautman from
1962; Ward and Takahashi. These are the waypoints the secondary literature
commonly gives for the theorem's return to physics, and
[[Noether's theorems/History/The recovery in field theory|the page carrying
them]] states that none was checked against the primary papers.
